'''Catcher''' is a 4★ [[Physical]] [[Defender]] [[Operator]] from [[Endfield Industries]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. He is a [[Great Sword]] user who can grant {{G|Protect|Protection}} to allies and {{G|Weaken|Weaken}} enemies.

==Profile==
"Need defensive cover? I shall give you my best."<br/>Catcher serves on [[Operations Team Z7]] in Endfield, responsible for cover and logistical support. Backed by full military training, he draws on his extensive knowledge to guide his teammates through critical moments. Born into a military family within the [[Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce]], he was raised with the love of devoted parents and older siblings. The pain and sickness caused by a childhood accident never brought him down. Instead, they shaped him into the steadfast warrior he is today.<br/>Catcher may be the youngest on the team, but his maturity far surpasses that of his peers. He can work seamlessly with everyone, readily cover when a teammate struggles, and even prepare a camp meal tailored to everyone's needs. With him around, the team always feels safe and at ease.<br/>"I have recently reviewed everyone's suggestions and improved my wildlands stew recipe... Feel free to give it a taste if you're curious, Endmin."
